text:
pia: HelioTrope legal needs a short perf summary + runbook before we sign. Scope: streaming chat (1k ctx) + real-time embeddings. They care about p95 token-stream, predictable microbursts, and a clear failure-mode playbook. Can eng/ops outline a compact runbook + committed vs burst cost sketch?
mark: quick clarifiers: model = 13B quant by default? want an FP16 comparison if we miss SLA? sustained qps and burst size? embeddings qps and dim?
pia: yes 13B-quant preferred. target p95 <= 320ms for streamed tokens. sustained 65 qps, microbursts to 280 qps for up to 4 minutes. embeddings: 1100 reqs/min, 768-d. FP16 optional fallback if quant doesn't hit SLA.
dev: plan: 4 phases — smoke, warmup (cache population), sustained plateau, burst cycles + cold-start test. include a cache-eviction scenario and a graceful-fallback A/B switch to 7B. We'll use anonymized sample prompts (avg prompt ~130 tokens, gen ~220).
dev: runbook draft:
```
phase 0 - smoke: 3m @ 1-2 qps (auth + payload shape)
phase 1 - warmup: 15m step ramp to 35 qps (populate prefix + KV caches)
phase 2 - sustain: ramp -> hold 65 qps for 30m (collect token & request percentiles)
phase 3 - bursts: 4 cycles 4m @ 280 qps with 3m cooldowns (observe queueing & errors)
phase 4 - cold-start: restart one node & fire 12 concurrent streams to measure tail
extra: cache-eviction test: artificially flush prefix cache and re-run short warmup
metrics: token p50/p95/p99, request-level p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, GPU util, queue_depth, 5xx%, fallback_count
```
mark: loadgen tooling: vegeta for non-streamed calls, a tiny Node SSE harness for streaming. example stream call: `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @payload.json https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/stream`
kira: infra sketch: sustained 65 qps on 13B-quant -> approx 2.5 A100-eq GPUs. we recommend committing 3 units for headroom. bursts to 280 qps -> +3 pre-warmed on-demand GPUs. commit 3 units, burst pool 3.
mark: quick back-of-envelope pricing (procurement-friendly): commit 3 units => ~$72k/month (ballpark). burst burn ~ $130/hr per GPU * 3 => $390/hr while active. if they want daily predictable bursts, we can propose a reserved burst buffer at discount.
pia: security asks from HelioTrope: HSM-backed customer KMS, VPC peering, per-request audit logs for 90 days, signed DPA, SOC2. also they want an ops checklist for emergency fallback. Can security confirm POC options?
kira: for POC we can create a temporary key in our account and provide log snapshots + VPC peering. long-term: customer-managed KMS HSM in their cloud required. we'll capture audit logs and a container scan artifact. need their security contact + signed minimal DPA for log sharing.
oliver-cust: security lead is oliver.s@heliotrope.co, will send questionnaire shortly. HSM preferred, can do cloud-KMS for POC. please include fallback behaviors and expected error codes.
dev: failure-mode summary to hand to their SRE: 1) cold-start tail spikes (mitigate: pre-warm nodes & keep-alive), 2) KV cache-miss storms when new prompts arrive (mitigate: staged warmup + prefix caching + TTL tuning), 3) ingress fan-in and upstream retries amplifying load (mitigate: token-bucket ingress shaping + queue thresholds), 4) degraded model under memory pressure (mitigate: swap to 7B auto-route + graceful 503 with info). We'll include circuit-breaker triggers and a runbook for each.
mark: experiment notes: we'll capture two key CSVs: per-phase latency CSV (phase,qps,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens_per_s,gpu_util_pct,queue_depth,errors_pct,fallback_evts) and an embeddings ingest CSV (qps,avg_latency_ms,errors_pct,throughput_vectors/s).
infra-bot: deploy-preview: dedicated/poc-heliotrope-01 -> provisioning started at 2025-03-18T14:20:00Z :rocket:
pia: timeline: can we run smoke+warmup tomorrow morning? deliver CSV + 1-page exec summary within 48h?
dev: yes. I'll own loadgen & payloads, mark will do infra profiling & cost refine, kira will handle security/KMS/VPC steps. oliver please send security questionnaire and SSO contact.
oliver-cust: sending questionnaire & SSO contact now. will also request legal to fast-track a minimal DPA.
pia: final note — include cold-start distribution plots in the appendix (p95/p99 pre/post warm), and a short paragraph about expected cost delta if they opt for dedicated commit 4 vs 3. we'll attach the CSV to the CRM deal record.
mark: action items recap: dev (loadgen + results), mark (infra profile + refined cost), kira (security checklist + KMS steps), oliver (security + legal contacts). I'll prepare the pricing appendix after profiling.
pia: thanks team — keep updates in-thread. once we have CSV I'll draft the vendor annex for procurement. :thumbsup:
